description: Simple, fast, privacy-focused alternative to Google Analytics.

promotion.reason: Approved by the owner. Qualified as offered on 2026-09-12: a real install of Umami 3.3.1, upstream's current release proved it starts, opens to a first screen with a clear next step, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data and generated credentials intact, and removes everything it created. The definition comes from Runtipi's app store.

risk_notes: Creates 2 Docker containers and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Generates 2 credentials of its own, keeps them beside the app's data, and reuses them if you reinstall.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Signs in first as admin with the password umami; change it the first time you sign in.
You add a website, then paste its script into your own pages; visits are recorded here and nowhere else.
Keeps everything in PostgreSQL beside it.
